name: Vedanta Society of Tucson
reason: Too thin: vedantatucson.org (GoDaddy site, robots allows) is a small satellite of the Vedanta Society of Southern California with no programme, class or talk pages of its own, no recordings and no channel linked; only quotation pages (Meditation, Suggested Readings) and a news list. Email vedanta.tucson.az@gmail.com is published on /contact-us. Fewer than 3 listable items.
